decisions.reason: This module is closely related to the firm's core practice-management knowledge and installed base, so under an absorptive-capacity view the firm can learn quickly from early use, refine it with in-house development and support, and is therefore more likely to keep than withdraw it.

Secure healthcare messaging fits the firm's regulatory and digital-workflow capabilities very well, and the visible KIM 1.5 update suggests strong internal learning and commitment in a strategically important area, making withdrawal within a year unlikely.
